effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

transitions.historical_text: Activate this card by Tributing 1 face-up monster on your side of the field that includes "Ninja" in its card name. Special Summon 1 Beast-Type, Winged Beast-Type, or Insect-Type monster with a Level equal to or less than the Level of the Tributed card + 3 from your hand or Deck to your side of the field. When this card is removed from your side of the field, destroy the monster.
transitions.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: after the Ninja is Tributed, if no Beast, Winged Beast or Insect monster of a legal Level is in the hand or Deck, the goat script reveals both zones (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script simply does nothing. No lineage version prints reveal wording.

transitions.historical_text: Activate this card by Tributing 1 face-up monster on your side of the field that includes "Ninja" in its card name. transitions.summary: Separate per-card era allowance: the modern s.cfilter requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,lv+3,e,tp)` before a 'Ninja' counts as a legal Tribute for the activation cost, and the goat cfilter drops that clause entirely. In the period implementation the card can therefore be activated and the Ninja released as cost with nothing summonable at that Level, losing the Ninja for no return. The packet dates no end for this per-card allowance.

review.notes: Baseline text is lineage v1 (DR2-EN164, Dark Revelation Volume 2, 2005-10-20), which postdates the GOAT 2005-04-01 snapshot by about six and a half months - see era_mismatch_ack. Remaining script differences are non-behavioural: 0x2b is SET_NINJA's value, RACE_BEAST+RACE_WINGEDBEAST+RACE_INSECT equals the bitwise-or form, and LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK equals LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK. The restructuring of the summon block (`if tc then ... else GoatConfirm end` around SpecialSummonStep/SpecialSummonComplete) exists only to host the reveal branch; SetCardTarget and the leave-field destruction in s.desop are identical in both files. Text lineage v1 -> v2 (TU07-EN019, 2012-01-01) -> v3 (OP02-EN011, 2016-07-15) -> v4 (SHVA-EN028, 2018-08-16) is cosmetic: PSCT semicolon form, 'is removed from your side of the field' -> 'leaves the field', and 'the Level of the Tributed card + 3' -> 'the Level the Tributed monster had on the field +3', which the script already implements by capturing the Level at cost time (e:SetLabel(rg:GetFirst():GetLevel()+3)). Intermediate-state reasoning as for the other GoatConfirm cards: the two ruling transitions are unordered, no upstream implementation covers the state between them, and none is attached because GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
